meta.title: Caldeira VM — A lightweight, deterministic virtual machine for microcontrollers
meta.description: Caldeira VM is a lightweight, deterministic virtual machine for microcontrollers. Portable bytecode, an open development ecosystem, and a stable execution environment for long-lived embedded software.
meta.ogDescription: A lightweight, deterministic virtual machine for microcontrollers.

hero.title: A lightweight, deterministic virtual machine for microcontrollers.
hero.description: Caldeira VM provides a stable execution environment for embedded applications: deterministic execution, hardware portability, and predictable behavior — built for long-lived embedded software, maintainable firmware, and an open developer ecosystem.

installation.title: Install Caldeira VM
installation.description: Install the latest public bootstrap environment with one command.
installation.note: The bootstrap script downloads and manages Caldeira VM SDK versions. It requires curl, python3 and unzip.

why.title: Why Caldeira VM
why.description: Modern embedded systems often require long product lifetimes, maintainable firmware, and predictable behavior. Caldeira VM is designed around these constraints.
why.firmwareLongevityDesc: Separate application logic from the underlying microcontroller implementation, so firmware can outlive a single hardware generation.
why.hardwareChangesDesc: Move software across supported hardware targets without rewriting the application, reducing the cost of hardware evolution.
why.portabilityDesc: A stable execution environment keeps behavior consistent when the target platform changes.
why.predictableExecutionDesc: Deterministic execution makes embedded software easier to reason about, test, and validate.
why.softwareEvolutionDesc: A stable bytecode interface gives firmware a controlled path to evolve over time.
why.embeddedConstraintsDesc: Designed for microcontroller-based systems, where resources, reliability, and maintainability matter.

concepts.title: Core concepts
concepts.description: The technical ideas behind Caldeira VM, presented without marketing.
concepts.deterministicDesc: The VM executes programs in a predictable, repeatable way — important for embedded systems where behavior must be trusted.
concepts.portabilityDesc: Applications are written once and run on supported targets through a stable execution environment.
concepts.stableEnvDesc: A consistent runtime contract between application and hardware, independent of the target's specifics.
concepts.maintainabilityDesc: Separation of concerns makes long-lived firmware easier to maintain and update in the field.
concepts.evolutionDesc: Controlled evolution of the platform and its toolchain, without breaking the applications that rely on it.
concepts.embeddedDesc: Built for microcontrollers and resource-constrained systems from the ground up.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: Caldeira VM is composed of two layers: a public open ecosystem and a proprietary core.
architecture.proprietaryNote: The proprietary core is owned by Sky Home Srl. Commercial products integrating it require a separate commercial license. It is not open source and is not publicly downloadable.
